description.content:
List files with optional filtering and pagination.

Filter by `file_name`, `file_ids`, or `external_file_id`.
Supports cursor-based pagination and custom ordering.

query.description: The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 50, maximum is 1000.
A page token received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
A comma-separated list of fields to order by, sorted in ascending order. Use 'field_name desc' to specify descending order.

Upload a file using multipart/form-data.

Set `purpose` to indicate how the file will be used:
`user_data`, `parse`, `extract`, `classify`, `split`,
`sheet`, or `agent_app`.

Returns the created file metadata including its ID for use
in subsequent parse, extract, or classify operations.

formdata.description: (Required) The intended purpose of the file. Valid values: 'user_data', 'parse', 'extract', 'split', 'classify', 'sheet', 'agent_app'. This determines the storage and retention policy for the file.
